protocol.gear: T3 power80 pure none, legacy currentChoice baseline/echo per candidate frozen from preceding study
protocol.selection: Before observing heldout outcomes, choose one globally best candidate per family gem/skill/leader by mean score gain among fixed eligible bottom20. If no positive candidate, family is not adopted. Each individual character then may retain native option if its training mean gain<=0 (no previous0.25 threshold). Publish both forced option and option-preserving results. No choices are retuned after heldout.
protocol.eligible: gem R/SR strength<=14, skill and leader fixed prior bottom20 character-specific proposals, no top group retargeting
protocol.screenScope: all69 for gem modes (appropriation/option choice), fixedBottom20 for normal skill and leader modes
protocol.leaderOpportunityCost: native-original crown vs native-self crown vs new-self crown, target20 only self crown; others retain native-original
protocol.score: 70*win+20*wave-normalized enemyHP progress+10*survivors/4. Not a win percentage.
limits: Skill and stone acquisition costs not calibrated
Gem uses1equipment slot; skills are additional character passives; leader uses crown, not equal economic budgets
Legacy tank comparison uses healer crown, cross-role absolute character ranking is invalid
Leader_unity four-role condition is satisfied in default intact formations; requirement cost itself needs separate stress tests
Specialized effects may not trigger in six contexts; microQA is distinct from gameplay outcome evidence
protocol.selectionApplicabilityReason: Template prerequisites known before outcome aggregation; do not dilute each niche effect by20 non-applicable candidates. Overall distribution later includes all69.

selection.rankingRule: one globally best per family by mean gain of pre-specified applicable fixed-bottom candidates; leader net vs original crown; individual retain-native choice from positive training mean only

rejectedValidation.reason: best leader by predeclared original-crown net criterion remained negative; separately validate failed proposal and preselected individual retain-native alternative

heldout.resampling: 2000 paired resamples of the30 seed blocks preserving all6 contexts and69 candidates; intervals describe this fixture, not player population
heldout.note: native_self contains fixed20 only and retains native rows for all other49, so reused rows are not counted as new battles

limits: Not an exhaustive game balance or builds ranking
Individual choices frozen from training; optional rows reuse the matching native/proposal results without adding battles
Selected best failed leader remains rejected globally; optional alternative is follow-up only
Different proposals have different acquisition/slot/crown costs
Raw counter units differ and are not total successful damage increases
Do not add independent mode improvements as if a combined build were simulated
